programmes.d: Academy Award winner Cuba Gooding Jr. stars as an ex-felon on a path of redemption, defying convention when he establishes a chess club for inner-city teenagers in D.C.
A man must survive a prison where hardened criminals battle to the death for the wardens' entertainment. Starring movie icon Jean-Claude Van Damme.
Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.
On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.
A tough cop (Jason Statham) is dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers.

While on a hiking trip to reconnect with his son after the death of his wife, Ray Keene (John Cusack) stumbles into a nightmare scenario of paid assassins and ex-military guns for hire led by the mysterious Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman).

One Black and one white woman in 1955 Montgomery, Alabama must decide what they are going to do in response to the famous bus boycott led by Martin Luther King. Starring Whoopi Goldberg ("Ghost") and Sissy Spacek ("In the Bedroom").
In this crime thriller, mercenary John Seeger (Steven Seagal, "Exit Wounds") attempts to break into Eastern Europe's most impenetrable prison and free the son of a notorious drug lord.
A decorated homicide detective (Steven Seagal) journeys through Memphis' depraved underworld to face off against a perverse serial killer in this action thriller.
In this twisting cop thriller, an alcoholic detective (Sylvester Stallone) is sent to a remote detox clinic after a serial killer targets his friends and family.
Motivated by victory and revenge, modern duelists John and Colt take on the underground gunfighting world. Starring Ryan Kwanten, Freida Pinto and Mickey Rourke.

A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.
When a series of deja vu events occur, a man (Danny Glover) is forced to re-examine his past and future.
An American prisoner (Dolph Lundgren, "Rocky IV") in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped American woman.
